_comment: Crop config for the Space Renegade sheets. region = grid area as fractions of the full image (x,y,w,h). labelCut trims the caption bar inside each cell (fraction of cell height). Run slice-sheets.mjs with --debug and inspect the *.overlay.png files, then nudge these numbers until every box hugs its sprite. Labels are in reading order, left-to-right then top-to-bottom.

sheets._note: labelCut is large here because each cell contains the stat bars + caption under the art; we keep only the weapon art. Tune with --debug.
